name: toolbox-core
description: Sovereign Mainframe Toolbox — portable intelligence engines for StickThemAnywhere and allied systems.

tools.name: StickerEngine — Naming Tool
tools.description: Normalizes raw strings into canonical uppercase-hyphen sticker codes. Provides slug generation, display name derivation, and batch normalization.

tools.name: StickerEngine — Taxonomy Tool
tools.description: In-memory taxonomy tree operations. Mirrors Convex taxonomy table logic without DB imports. Supports upsert dedup, ancestor walks, danger-level filtering, and structural validation.

tools.name: Gematria Engine
tools.description: Standard Gematria (Mispar Hechrachi) calculator with optional extended sofit values and theosophical digit reduction.

tools.name: Redesign Analyzer Engine
tools.description: Scores and classifies business websites as PRIMARY_TARGET, MONITOR, or PASS based on visual score, mobile responsiveness, CTA density, load speed, and trust signals.

tools.name: Tool Manufacturing — Public API Packager
tools.description: Wraps internal Sovereign Mainframe engines (Gematria Scorer, Redesign Analyser, 3D Globe API) into versioned, metered Public API endpoints. API-Key management system: generate, validate, rate-limit (100–10,000 req/day by tier), rotate, revoke, and meter usage with per-tool breakdowns and USD-cent revenue estimates. Standalone Bun server on port 4002.

tools.name: Tool Manufacturing — Affiliate Link Manager
tools.description: Full affiliate link lifecycle: seed registry (8 offers across health, tech, software, books, crypto), Pillar 11 slot mapping (ad-slot / typing-segment / banner / product-card), HTTP HEAD health-check sweep with configurable TTL (1 h default), dead-link auto-swap with fallback resolution (named fallback → highest-priority active in same category), swap event log, leakage report, and offer scraper adapter for network APIs. Zero revenue leakage guarantee: every dead slot is replaced or flagged UNFILLED.

tools.name: Agentic Protocol — MCP Gateway & Bot-Sovereignty
tools.description: Exposes all active Sovereign Mainframe pillars as MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool and resource descriptors. Bot-Sovereignty enforces HMAC-SHA256 agent identity verification with four access tiers (PUBLIC / VERIFIED / SOVEREIGN / KEYMAKER) — gating Gematria, 4D spatial, and spectral data to verified agents only. Includes rate limiting (60 req/min default), audit log, and token revocation.

tools.name: Biological Audit — Parasite Tracker
tools.description: Uses High-Spectral Veil composite frame sequences to detect microscopic ectoparasite motion signatures. Extracts per-block NIR luminance oscillation time-series, estimates dominant Hz via zero-crossing rate, clusters spatially adjacent candidates, and scores against four taxon signature profiles (Demodex folliculorum/brevis, Sarcoptes, Pthirus). Cross-references findings with an 8-entry Cures vs. Suppressions treatment database with peer-reviewed references — including Ivermectin (oral + topical), Tea Tree Oil, Permethrin, Zinc adjunct, and CONTRAINDICATED entries (topical corticosteroids).

tools.name: Sovereign Ledger — Yod Token Contract (י)
tools.description: ERC-20 Yod Token (symbol: י) with a built-in 10% Tithe-Tax on every transfer, auto-routed to the GAB Research Vault address set at deployment. Includes typed ABI, pure-TS helpers (computeTithe, formatYod, parseYod, buildTransferCalldata, decodeTransferEvent, decodeTithePaidEvent), and a Move (Sui) scaffold comment block for future cross-chain porting.

tools.name: Sovereign Ledger — Ledger Bridge (NAS ↔ On-Chain)
tools.description: Connects the Yellow Pages DB to on-chain Yod token Transfer and TithePaid events via EVM JSON-RPC polling (zero external dependencies — raw fetch). When a Yod deposit to a watched Yellow Pages wallet is detected, awards Agent Credits and POSTs to the Synology NAS agent endpoint. Runs as a standalone Bun process or inside the api Docker container. Handles catch-up from configurable block depth on startup.

tools.name: Monetized Interface — Ad Sequencer Engine
tools.description: Priority-weighted 3D ad asset rotation engine (3.3 s intervals). Tracks impressions and clicks per-asset and per-advertiser in a Yellow Pages ledger. Provides pure-math helpers for WebGL rotation angle and billboard matrix computation. Zero framework imports — hooks into Three.js, Babylon.js, or raw WebGL via lifecycle callbacks.

tools.name: Monetized Interface — Typing Engine
tools.description: Real-time typing challenge engine backed by the GAB Historical-Truth segment library. Calculates WPM (5-char standard), raw WPM, accuracy, consistency (inverse of inter-key latency CV), and ETA per keystroke. Returns a character-level diff array for colour-coded UI rendering. Zero framework imports.

tools.name: High-Spectral Veil — Spectral Shift Engine
tools.description: Maps NIR/SWIR/UV/LWIR data streams into a Composite Visible Frame via configurable band-to-RGB mapping, per-channel gain, gamma correction, and LUT presets. Anomaly detection pipeline flags VELOCITY_EXCEED, THERMAL_GHOST, UV_FLARE, PHASE_INVERSION, and SPECTRAL_SPIKE events using z-scoring, Pearson correlation, and block-motion estimation.

tools.name: Omni-View — Sensor Fusion Engine
tools.description: GPS/GNSS normalization with inverse-accuracy-weighted ECEF fusion across Drone, Phone, RTK, and Satellite sources. Wi-Fi RSSI → 3D occupancy trilateration using Log-Distance Path Loss model and least-squares solver.

tools.name: Yellow Pages — Schema Generator
tools.description: Takes a JSON Intent (description + field list) and outputs a structured column array with inferred data types, roles, SQL types, Sheets format strings, and a ready-to-use CREATE TABLE statement.

tools.name: Yellow Pages — Formula Engine
tools.description: Generates Excel/Google Sheets compatible formula strings (SUM, VLOOKUP, GROWTH, FORECAST, CAGR, etc.) from column letters and FormulaContext. Platform-aware: handles Sheets vs Excel syntax differences.

tools.name: Pre-noetic Atmospheric Conditions — Physics Engine
tools.description: Models pre-Flood atmospheric conditions from a vapor canopy weight variable. Computes sea-level barometric pressure (P = ρgh), O2 partial pressure (Dalton's Law), and radiation shielding index. References Dillow (1981) and Vardiman (1994) canopy estimates.

schemas.name: Pre-noetic Atmospheric Conditions — UI State
schemas.description: JSON Schema tracking user slider positions (Pressure, O2, Radiation, Canopy) and derived physics outputs for the atmosphere information overlay.

convexMirrors.notes: taxonomy.tool.ts is the DB-free equivalent. Run validateTree() before calling Convex upsertNode to catch errors early.
Identical letter tables and reduction algorithm. Safe to call on client without a Convex context.

gabTaxonomy.description: GAB (Sovereign Taxonomy) domain registrations for all toolbox systems.

domains.name: Historical Physics
domains.description: Pre-Flood and paleo-atmospheric physics models. Covers canopy hypothesis, barometric pressure differentials, hyperoxic environments, and radiation shielding under alternate atmospheric compositions.

domains.name: Business Automation
domains.description: Eighth pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Automates business data modeling, spreadsheet formula generation, lead tracking, and Monte Carlo revenue projections for Yellow Pages-style business intelligence.

domains.name: Command and Control
domains.description: Ninth pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Geo-spatial situational awareness dashboard. Fuses GNSS/GPS from heterogeneous sensors, converts Wi-Fi RSSI into 3D occupancy maps, and renders everything through a self-hosted offline MapLibre tile stack on the Synology.

nodes.name: GNSS Fusion
nodes.description: Normalize and fuse GPS/GNSS from Drone, Phone, RTK, and Satellite sources.

nodes.name: Wi-Fi Occupancy Mapping
nodes.description: RSSI-to-distance conversion and 3D trilateration for indoor/outdoor occupancy grids.

nodes.name: Map Rendering
nodes.description: Offline vector/raster tile hosting via TileServer GL (MapLibre-compatible).

domains.name: Discernment and Vision
domains.description: Tenth and final pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Multi-spectral perception engine: fuses NIR/SWIR/UV/LWIR into composite visible frames, applies configurable LUT presets, and runs a statistical anomaly pipeline to flag non-physical movement, thermal displacement, UV bursts, and spectral phase inversions. Streams live glasses feed to the Synology for real-time Ollama AI analysis.

nodes.name: Band Mapping
nodes.description: NIR→R, SWIR→G, UV→B default mapping with per-channel gain and gamma.

nodes.name: LUT Presets
nodes.description: NATURAL | ENHANCED_CONTRAST | THERMAL_OVERLAY | UV_HIGHLIGHT | GHOST_MODE

nodes.name: Spiritual Entity Focus
nodes.description: Unfiltered Mode — all noise-reduction disabled, raw multi-band data, GHOST_MODE LUT.

nodes.name: UAP Tracker
nodes.description: Multi-Spectrum Contrast — cross-band persistence and velocity anomaly detection.

nodes.name: Thermal Ghosting
nodes.description: Heat Displacement — LWIR signatures without visible-spectrum correlation.

nodes.name: Vision Sync Stream
nodes.description: Real-time WebSocket ingest from glasses feed → Ollama llava AI analysis → SSE anomaly broadcast.

domains.name: Commercial Engine
domains.description: Eleventh pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Drives all revenue-generating interfaces: 3D ad rotation with impression/click ledger feeding the Yellow Pages, and a real-time typing engine drawing content from the Historical-Truth domain. Designed for WebGL-based frontends on the StickThemAnywhere storefront.

nodes.name: 3D Asset Rotation
nodes.description: Priority-weighted queue cycling 3D food models and ad textures every 3.3 seconds. Hooks: onAssetChange → load mesh, onTick → drive rotation angle.

nodes.name: Impression Ledger
nodes.description: Tracks billable impressions (≥1 s visible), clicks with normalised coordinates, CPI/CPC revenue by advertiser. Exports to Yellow Pages DB via exportLedgerSnapshot().

nodes.name: WebGL Helpers
nodes.description: computeRotationAngle(elapsedMs, rpm), buildBillboardMatrix(tx,ty,tz,scale), filterScheduledAssets(assets, nowMs).

nodes.name: Historical-Truth Segments
nodes.description: 8-segment built-in library sourced from the GAB Historical-Truth domain. getSegments({ topic, difficulty, limit, shuffle }) for query-style retrieval.

nodes.name: Real-Time Metrics
nodes.description: WPM (5-char standard), rawWpm, accuracy, consistency (inverse inter-key latency CV), ETA, errorsPerWord — all computed per keystroke via processKey(key).

nodes.name: Character Diff Display
nodes.description: diffTyped(typed, target) returns [{char, status: correct|incorrect|pending}] for real-time colour-coded rendering in any UI framework.

nodes.name: NAS 3D Asset Store
nodes.description: Synology NAS asset store for 3D food models (GLTF/GLB), billboard textures (PNG/WebP), holographic overlays, video textures, and HDRI environment maps. Synced via GitHub Actions sync-to-nas workflow.

domains.name: Kingdom Finance
domains.description: Twelfth pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. On-chain Yod Token (י) with an immutable 10% Tithe-Tax auto-routing to the GAB Research Vault. The Ledger Bridge connects Yellow Pages business accounts to on-chain Yod deposits, awarding Agent Credits on the Synology NAS upon each verified deposit.

nodes.name: Token Mechanics
nodes.description: ERC-20 standard with 18 decimals. Symbol: י (U+05D9). Minting is owner-only. transferOwnership supported. Move (Sui) scaffold in comment block for cross-chain porting.

nodes.name: Tithe Tax System
nodes.description: 10% (1000 bps) on every transfer and transferFrom. Tithe auto-credited to gabResearchVault (immutable). Rate adjustable by owner up to 20% hard-cap. TithePaid event emitted for ledger indexing. vaultTransfer() is tithe-exempt (owner-only, vault parties only).

nodes.name: Pure TS Helpers
nodes.description: computeTithe(), formatYod(), parseYod(), buildTransferCalldata(), decodeTransferEvent(), decodeTithePaidEvent() — all zero-dependency, usable on NAS without ethers.js.

nodes.name: On-Chain Event Polling
nodes.description: EVM JSON-RPC eth_getLogs polling (zero external deps). Catches Transfer and TithePaid events. Start-up catch-up from configurable block depth. Default poll interval 6 s (one Polygon block).

nodes.name: Yellow Pages DB Sync
nodes.description: fetchYpAccounts() loads wallet→businessId map from YP API every 5 min. appendYpLedgerEntry() persists every event as a typed LedgerEntry. Balance tracking in-memory with bigint precision.

nodes.name: Agent Credits System
nodes.description: When a Yod deposit ≥ creditThresholdBaseUnits (default 1 Yod) is detected to a watched YP wallet, computeAgentCredits() floors to whole tokens and triggerAgentCredit() POSTs to NAS_AGENT_URL with Bearer auth. AGENT_CREDIT LedgerEntry recorded.

nodes.name: GAB Research Vault
nodes.description: Immutable on-chain address receiving 10% of every Yod transaction. Accumulates totalTithePaid (readable on-chain). Vault rebalancing via owner-only vaultTransfer() — Tithe-exempt.

domains.name: Universal Governance
domains.description: Thirteenth and fourteenth pillars of the Sovereign Mainframe. Universal Governance covers two distinct sub-systems: the Agentic Protocol (MCP gateway, Bot-Sovereignty, pillar exposure) and the Biological Audit (spectral parasite detection, Cures vs. Suppressions database). Together they govern who and what may access the Mainframe, and what biological truth the Mainframe can observe.

nodes.name: MCP Pillar Registry
nodes.description: 13 MCP ToolDescriptors covering Pillars 1–13 + Pillar 14 bio-audit. 7 resource URIs (sovereign://...). Protocol version 2024-11-05.

nodes.name: Bot-Sovereignty
nodes.description: HMAC-SHA256 token system. Four access tiers: PUBLIC (no auth), VERIFIED (signed token), SOVEREIGN (Gematria/4D/spectral), KEYMAKER (full governance). Token format: base64url(identity).hmac. Audit log, rate limiter (60 req/min), revocation.

nodes.name: Capability Negotiation
nodes.description: McpGateway.negotiate() returns a tier-filtered McpCapabilityManifest. Agents only see tools they are authorised to call.

nodes.name: Spectral Parasite Detection
nodes.description: analyseForParasites() ingests Veil composite frames, extracts per-block NIR luminance oscillation series, estimates Hz via zero-crossing rate, clusters adjacent candidates, scores against 4 taxon signature profiles. Demodex Hz range: 0.05–0.5 Hz; Sarcoptes: 0.5–2.5 Hz.

domains.name: Marketplace Infrastructure
domains.description: Fifteenth pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Marketplace Infrastructure governs the external commercialisation of internal tools — packaging them as metered Public APIs with API-key management, and ensuring all Pillar 11 affiliate slots remain revenue-generating through automatic dead-link detection and replacement.

nodes.name: Public API Packaging
nodes.description: PublicApiGateway exposes internal tools as versioned REST endpoints. API key format: smf_{tier}_{32-hex}. Key lifecycle: create, validate, rotate, revoke. Metering: per-tool daily counters, overage billing in USD cents ($0.20–0.50 / 1 000 overage calls by tier). Standalone Bun server port 4002.

nodes.name: API Key Management
nodes.description: ApiKeyManager: in-memory store (port to Supabase/Convex for persistence). issueToken/rotate/revoke lifecycle. Per-key allowedTools, allowedOrigins, rateLimitRpdOverride. exportUsageReport() returns 30-day rollup with revenue estimates.

nodes.name: Affiliate Link Management
nodes.description: AffiliateLinkManager: seed registry with 8 built-in offers (health, tech, software, books, crypto). Maps offers to Pillar 11 ad-slots + typing-segments. HTTP HEAD health sweep every 1 h (configurable TTL). Dead-link auto-swap: named fallback → highest-priority active in same category → UNFILLED flag. SwapEvent log for audit trail. scrapeAffiliateOffers() adapter for live network feeds. estimateAnnualRevenueCents() forecasting helper.

nodes.name: Zero Revenue Leakage Protocol
nodes.description: Guarantee: no Pillar 11 ad slot remains dead longer than one health-check TTL cycle. Swap resolution order: 1) named fallbackOfferId on the dead offer, 2) highest-priority ACTIVE offer in same category, 3) UNFILLED — triggers onUnfilled() callback and appears in getRevenueLeakageReport(). All swaps emit a typed SwapEvent with SwapReason, timestampMs, and descriptive note.
